dedupe_keys.name: conventional and renewable energy systems optimization toolbox carnot

description: Conventional And Renewable eNergy systems Optimization Toolbox (CARNOT) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Solar-Institut Jülich der FH Aachen. CARNOT is a toolbox extension for MATLAB SIMULINK. It is a tool for the calculation and simulation of the thermal components of HVAC systems with regards to conventional and regenerative elements. The CARNOT Toolbox is a library of typical components of these systems. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Software: Matlab/Simulink. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is BSD 3-clause. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
